value.rationale: This is an exact natural classification of the joint arithmetic dependence of arbitrarily many Menon-type gcd statistics sampled at one reduced residue. It gives a sharp modulo-4 threshold, all odd-prime collision obstructions, and a nontrivial pairwise-to-full equivalence; it governs every increasing observable rather than a few moments. The explicit opposite-shift mean is only a previously implied illustration. The classification is motivated by the classical gcd-sum distribution question and can be checked locally without enumerating residues.
